stretch.name: STRETCH
stretch.oneLiner: Belgian manufacturer of seamless polyester stretch ceilings and walls, cold-mounted and installed in one day.
stretch.whatTitle: A new ceiling in one day.
stretch.description: STRETCH designs and makes seamless stretch ceilings and walls in Beveren-Waas, Belgium. The polyester membrane is mounted cold and installed in a single day, with acoustic, lighting and printed options. The company trades as Stretch Productions BV, founded in 2018, and serves Belgium from stretchplafond.be and international markets from stretch.mt.
bullets: Seamless polyester stretch ceilings and walls

stretch-sufit.description: Alto Design Sp. z o.o. has produced PVC stretch ceilings in Częstochowa since 2016, seamless up to 6.50 m. The company joined STRETCH Group in 2024. Its consumer installation brand, Stretch Sufit, is active in 17 Polish cities and has completed more than 4,000 projects.

re-sound.oneLiner: Belgian maker of circular acoustic panels and screens from recycled and sustainable materials, with a full take-back policy.
re-sound.description: Re-Sound makes acoustic panels and screens in Belgium from recycled and sustainable materials. It started in 2020 with yarn spun from recycled jeans. Every product can be returned at the end of its life and made into new panels. The range includes Interior panels and the Divide freestanding screen. Re-Sound was founded by Aaron Thierens.

hero.lead: STRETCH Group brings together a Belgian stretch-ceiling manufacturer, a Polish PVC factory and a Belgian circular-acoustics company. Each keeps its own name and website; the group connects them.

story.title: Built from the workshop up.
story.p1: The group’s story starts on the factory floor. In 2016 Alto Design opened a PVC stretch-ceiling factory in Częstochowa, Poland. In 2018 Stretch Productions BV was founded in Beveren-Waas, Belgium, to design and install seamless polyester stretch ceilings and walls — cold-mounted, finished in a day.
story.p2: Re-Sound added acoustics with a circular twist: panels and screens made in Belgium from recycled and sustainable materials, starting from a yarn spun out of recycled jeans, with a take-back policy so every product can close the loop.
story.p3: In 2024 Alto Design joined STRETCH Group, bringing the factory and the Stretch Sufit installation brand into the group. Today the companies share know-how and markets while each runs its own brand and website:

offices.title: Four offices, two factories’ worth of know-how.

careersPage.body2: Open positions are published here and on the company websites. If nothing fits today, send an open application; we keep it on file and pass it to the right company.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains how STRETCH Group (“we”, “us”) collects and uses personal data when you visit stretchgroup.be or contact us through it. We are the data controller for that processing.

p: We only collect what we need. When you use the contact form or send an open application, we collect the details you provide: your name, email address, company, which company your message concerns, and the contents of your message.

When you browse the site we may also collect standard technical and usage data — such as device, browser and pages viewed — through cookies and similar technologies, but only to the extent you have consented. You can review and change your choices at any time via “Manage cookies” in the footer.

We use the details you submit to answer your enquiry and to forward it to the group company that can help you (STRETCH, Stretch Sufit / Alto Design or Re-Sound). This processing is based on your request and our legitimate interest in responding to it.
Where you have given consent, we use analytics technologies to understand how the site is used and to improve it. You may withdraw consent at any time.

Non-essential cookies and analytics — including Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity — are only loaded after you accept them. Until then they remain disabled through consent mode. Essential cookies needed to operate the site and remember your cookie choice do not require consent.

To protect our forms against automated abuse we may use Cloudflare Turnstile, a privacy-preserving verification service provided by Cloudflare, Inc. It evaluates technical signals from your browser to tell people apart from bots and does not track you across sites. We also record technical details of form submissions, such as IP address and browser type, for the same purpose. This processing is based on our legitimate interest in keeping the site secure.

We do not sell your personal data. We share it with the group company your enquiry concerns, and with service providers who help us operate the site and deliver messages — our hosting provider, our email provider and, where consented, our analytics providers — only as needed to perform those services. Some providers may process data outside the European Economic Area; in that case appropriate safeguards apply.

We keep enquiry data for as long as needed to handle your request and for our legitimate business and legal record-keeping, after which it is deleted or anonymised. Open applications are kept for a limited period unless you ask us to delete them earlier.

Subject to applicable law, you have the right to access, correct, delete or restrict the processing of your personal data, to object to processing, to data portability, and to withdraw consent at any time. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. In Belgium this is the Data Protection Authority (Gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit).

This site presents the group and its companies for general information only. It sells nothing and publishes no prices. When you submit a form, you confirm that the information you provide is accurate and that you are entitled to share it. Submitting an enquiry or an application does not create a contract or an employment relationship.

You may not copy, reproduce or reuse it without prior written permission, except as permitted by law.

The site links to the websites of the group companies and may link to other third-party websites. Each of those sites has its own terms and privacy policy. We are not responsible for the content or practices of sites we do not operate.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect or consequential loss arising from your use of, or inability to use, the site, or from reliance on its content. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded under applicable law.

We may update these terms from time to time; the version published on this page applies. These terms are governed by Belgian law, and the Belgian courts have jurisdiction, to the extent permitted by law.
